title: RAC: Request-adaptive Configuration for Efficient Speculative Decoding
selection_reason: The official IFAAMAS AAMAS 2026 Extended Abstract confirms RAC uses request features and historical execution feedback in an RL/MDP policy to select draft model and speculative length per request. Its text-generation benchmark results report maximum speedups of 2.02× over autoregressive decoding and 1.37× over vanilla speculative decoding; this is a direct LLM inference-efficiency contribution.
venue: Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
